scope: Captured regular source/input, count/overview/identity, factory cancellation/setup, shared cache admission and fixed resource release; shared support extraction compatibility. Wire/lease/converter loop has a separate independent reviewer.
checks: Original is opened NONBLOCK/CLOEXEC, fstat-validated as bounded regular input, captured-size hashed, decoded through the same FD, then stat/digest revalidated before and after service readiness.

Named input is exclusively created inside the admitted private directory, F32LE finite-scanned for normalized source overview/hash while copied, fsynced, reopened through descriptor-safe validation and reverified through that retained FD.
Actual raw N and exact48k M remain distinct; one cancellable sealed count plan is retained for seeks. Ring token and original/input/model digests are separate.
Existing five engine assets retain their offline meaning and Python invocation alias; service uses a separate pin. Final source/engine checks precede factory commit.
QProcess is constructed/used on the producer thread. Initial provider epoch is captured before setup success, and native load is deferred until actual prime changes epoch.

Setup results are first-result-wins and preserve the first primary error; setup failures notify the waiter. Factory cancellation registration is removed before final commit checks and is not captured by installed producer lifetime.

FactoryActive is mutex-protected, preventing early producer cleanup from resetting the retained input while factory performs final verification. Destruction/cleanup retries follow stop/join outside render.

Normal, offline-bank and live entry-count/byte-admission paths share root locking and count live reservation records once. Initial charge covers duplicate input and future service phases; the same record shrinks only after the anonymous copy closes.

Cleanup requires proven owned-group termination and validates the fixed tree before removal. Unknown/unsafe or unproven jobs remain; any remaining invalid live reservation blocks later admission rather than being ignored.
Root-requested250ms protocol grace precedes existing bounded group TERM/KILL/reap. Bridge closes Qt read channels before teardown waits so a flooding child cannot accumulate unread teardown buffers.

Shared descriptor/pin/hash/verification and process-group lifecycle retain existing offline behavior; original one-shot output accumulation, cache identities and publication paths stay in PreparedTrackStore.
concrete_findings_resolved_in_reviewed_b: Runtime-ready validator now has its own visible fixed four-role definition in the extracted support TU.
Final generic stopped-before-ready completion no longer overwrites an already-published primary setup error.

Cancellation before first reservation record publication can remove its owned known tree even if reservation.json was never created; conservative charge exists before publication for failed-rmdir restoration.
If mkdir succeeds but opening that new empty directory fails, the factory attempts bounded immediate unlink before rethrow, matching the existing Stage pattern.

Record-removal/rmdir failure attempts restoration under the same root lock; failed restoration leaves an invalid job that blocks all admission. Successful rmdir followed by root fsync failure is durability-only, not surviving PCM or an unproven process claim.
limits: This receipt is static source review only. No patches applied, compiler/moc/test/build/Git/native/model processes executed, or host-state/policy/audio queries made by this reviewer.
Exact cancellation during initial record write and mkdir/open failure are source-reviewed branches, not claimed deterministic tests.
Captured-file consistency is ordinary before/after identity/digest detection, not an adversarial atomic snapshot or same-user sandbox guarantee.
No filesystem failure guarantee that exact reservation bytes always survive; a remaining invalid job intentionally fails later admission closed.
No integrated playback/latency/physical-audio or universal numerical-equivalence qualification is inferred. Root owns actual GREEN and required checks.
